day1_insight: There's been no rain at all lately, so there's no runoff driving contamination, and strong summer sunlight is helping disinfect the water. The model's main signals right now: hours since high tide is lowering risk — the timing relative to high tide affects how concentrated bacteria are at the shoreline; no rain has fallen, so nothing is washing off the land into the surf; and wave height is lowering risk — bigger waves stir up the seabed and resuspend sediment-bound bacteria. The most recent sample, 6 days ago, was excellent at 20 MPN/100mL.
